title: Anomaly-Free Streak Across All Feeds
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=correlation:pair
| bin _time span=1d
| stats max(eval(if(abs(zscore)>3,1,0))) as had_anomaly by _time
| streamstats current=t sum(eval(if(had_anomaly=0,1,0))) as clean_streak reset_after="(had_anomaly=1)"
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many days in a row every personal signal stayed within normal range, a calm-life streak.
value: A clean streak across all feeds is a satisfying, holistic sign that life is running smoothly.
implementation: Detect daily anomalies across `index=personal`; track the anomaly-free streak.
visualization: Single-value tile of the anomaly-free-day streak.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many days in a row everything in your life stayed normal, a nice sign all is well.
